import "@redstone-finance/evm-connector/contracts/data-services/PrimaryProdDataServiceConsumerBase.sol";

contract ExampleRedstoneShowroom is PrimaryProdDataServiceConsumerBase {
    function getPrices() public view returns(uint256[] memory) {
        bytes32[] memory dataFeedIds = new bytes32[](2);
        dataFeedIds[0] = bytes32("BTC");
        dataFeedIds[1] = bytes32("ETH");
        return getOracleNumericValuesFromTxMsg(dataFeedIds);
    }
}

We Value Your Privacy

RedStone uses cookies to enhance your experience with our blockchain oracle services. We process your data in accordance with GDPR requirements to provide personalized content and analyze our traffic.

By clicking "Accept All", you consent to our use of cookies. Customize your preferences anytime.
Learn more | Privacy Policy | Terms of Service

Cookie Preferences

Manage your cookie settings for RedStone Finance services in accordance with GDPR requirements. You can change these settings at any time.

Strictly Necessary Required
Essential cookies required for RedStone Finance platform functionality. These cannot be switched off as they enable core features like secure transactions and user authentication.
Legal Basis: Legitimate Interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)
Cookies: redstone_cookie_consent, session_id, csrf_token
Retention: Session or 12 months
Performance & Analytics
Help us understand how users interact with RedStone Finance services to improve our blockchain oracle performance and user experience. All data is aggregated and anonymous.
Legal Basis: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)
Cookies: _ga, _ga_*, _gid, _hjSession_*, _hjSessionUser_*
Third Parties: Google Analytics, Hotjar
Retention: 2 years (Google), 1 year (Hotjar)
Targeting & Advertising
Used to deliver personalized content about RedStone Finance services and measure advertising effectiveness across blockchain and DeFi platforms.
Legal Basis: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)
Cookies: YSC, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE, _fbp, _fbc
Third Parties: YouTube, Facebook, Google Ads
Retention: 6 months to 2 years
Functionality
Enable enhanced functionality like language preferences, user dashboard settings, and personalized RedStone Finance features.
Legal Basis: Legitimate Interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)
Cookies: lang_pref, theme_mode, RDST_AD_TOU
Retention: 6 months to 1 year
